about: A small social app's tools, after the InstaVibe demo in a talk on Google's ADK and MCP: the two tools the demo exposed (create_post, create_event), calendar-style variants of the same actions, and the reads such an app has. The names are ours, written for this test; no code was copied.
source: the demo's two tool names as shown on screen; the other names are made up for this list

tools.name: create_post
tools.label: ask
tools.why: posts to a feed that other people read

tools.name: create_event
tools.label: ask
tools.why: creates an event that other people see and are invited to

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.label: ask
tools.why: the same in a shared calendar

tools.name: update_event
tools.label: ask
tools.why: changes an event that people have planned around

tools.name: reschedule_event
tools.label: ask
tools.why: moves an event; the attendees are told

tools.name: schedule_meeting
tools.label: ask
tools.why: puts a meeting in other people's calendars

tools.name: update_calendar
tools.label: ask
tools.why: changes a calendar that others share

tools.name: rsvp_event
tools.label: ask
tools.why: answers an invitation; the organizer sees the answer

tools.name: get_post
tools.label: allow
tools.why: reads, but post is one of red line 2's words, so the example asks: a false positive, like get_email

tools.name: get_invitations
tools.label: allow
tools.why: reads; whole words, so invitations is not invite

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.label: allow
tools.why: reads, but schedule is one of red line 2's words, so the example asks: a false positive
